parameters.system_prompt: You are an expert 3D low-poly papercraft designer, origami artist, and 3D unfold engineer. You design foldable low-poly figures made of simple primary geometric volumes where micro-details are illustrated flat on the paper surface. You follow the studio signature aesthetic: cute expressive eyes with circular white catchlights and vibrant paper colors. You generate exactly one image that follows all instructions. Never write any text, letters, watermark or labels. Every rule is mandatory and none may be broken.
parameters.negative_prompt: bust, headshot, portrait, close-up, cropped, truncated torso, severed neck, partial figure, wireframe, crease lines, black fold lines, black outline lines, blueprint markings, dark edge seams, shadow, floor shadow, ground shadow, drop shadow, contact shadow, ambient occlusion beneath model, cast shadow, dark ground, 3D extruded teeth, jagged 3D spikes, open mouth cavity, top-down view, high angle view, isometric view, tilted body, leaning body, floating feet, front view, side profile view, extra eyes, three eyes, one eye, floating eyes, gradients, text, watermark, labels, cell divider borders, CGI, clay, plastic, smooth rounded cartoon

prompt_templates.specific_subject:
low-poly faceted 3D papercraft model of {subject}. Seen in an EYE-LEVEL THREE-QUARTER VIEW, camera at the height of the subject's body (showing front and left-side facets), with all feet, paws or wheels resting on one flat horizontal ground plane.

Subject: {subject}.

{reference_instruction}

STUDIO INVARIANTS (MANDATORY):
- COMPLETE ENTIRE OBJECT: The entire complete {subject} must be 100% visible from end to end, fully centered with generous margin inside the cell. NEVER a bust, NEVER just a head, NEVER a close-up, NEVER cropped.
- EYE-LEVEL THREE-QUARTER VIEW: Every figure is seen from a three-quarter view with the camera level with the body, no top-down tilt, standing upright and level with all feet on one flat horizontal ground plane, never leaning or tilted.
- ABSOLUTELY ZERO SHADOWS: Completely plain, seamless flat neutral light grey #E5E5E5 background. ZERO floor shadows, ZERO cast shadows, ZERO contact shadows under base, ZERO ambient occlusion.
- CLEAN LOW-POLY PAPERCRAFT FACETS: Crisp planar polygon facets made of solid matte paper cardstock colors with directional flat-shading only. ABSOLUTELY ZERO BLACK OUTLINE STROKES, ZERO BLACK CREASE LINES, ZERO WIREFRAME, ZERO BLUEPRINT MARKS, ZERO FOLD GUIDE LINES. Facets meet cleanly without dark lines.
- 100% CLOSED GEOMETRIC VOLUMES: All primary forms are closed solid low-poly polyhedra suitable for papercraft folding.
- FLAT 2D UV TEXTURE DECALS: Fine surface details (spots, stripes, whiskers, headlights, teeth, decals) are 100% flat 2D decals printed directly on the facet surfaces, never protruding 3D physical spikes or open cavities.
- EYES: For living creatures, exactly two large cute expressive round eyes with circular white catchlights painted flat onto head facets. Never three eyes, never floating eyes.
- No shadows, no gradients, no text, no labels, no cell dividers, no grid lines.

parameters.style_reference_note: STYLE REFERENCE (attached image 1): copy ONLY its papercraft rendering style: low-poly folded cardstock, crisp planar facets, flat colors, cute round eyes with white catchlights, seamless light background. Never copy its subject, species, markings or colors.
parameters.reference_note_template: SUBJECT PHOTOS (attached images {first} onward, {count} photo(s) of the real subject): Faithfully preserve the subject's identity, proportions, body shape, colors and the EXACT placement and size of every marking shown in these photos, rendered in the style of the style reference, in authentic low-poly folded papercraft cardstock style with crisp polygon facets. Maintain the strict eye-level three-quarter viewpoint with the body level and all feet on one flat ground plane, complete entire figure without cropping, closed solid volumes, flat 2D UV texture decals for teeth and spots, exactly two eyes, and ABSOLUTELY ZERO FLOOR SHADOWS.

parameters.base_clause: the whole figure stands on a very simple low plinth: a thin flat rectangular slab of solid saturated warm terracotta-brown cardstock, clearly different from the grey background, only slightly wider than the figure, with a perfectly flat horizontal top and bottom, so the feet, paws or wheels rest on the slab

maturity_descriptions: Cell (0,0) [Top-Left]: Ultra-childlike, cute, chubby, chibi, highly simplified origami toy with large bold facets and friendly exaggerated proportions in strict eye-level three-quarter view
Cell (0,1) [Top-Center]: Playful youthful papercraft figure with soft rounded geometry and cheerful character in strict eye-level three-quarter view

Cell (0,2) [Top-Right] (Default Pick #3): Studio signature training style — balanced geometric proportions, expressive signature eyes with white catchlight, exact reference colors and features, translated into clean planar facets and with flat 2D UV texture details on closed volumes in strict eye-level three-quarter view

critical_rules: Strict 3x2 grid of exactly 6 equal cells: exactly 3 columns (left, center, right) and exactly 2 rows (top, bottom). Exactly one figure per cell, totaling exactly 6 figures. Never 4 columns, never 7 or 8 figures.
Strict eye-level three-quarter view in EVERY cell, camera level with the body, all feet on one flat horizontal ground plane, body upright and never tilted.
Zero text, zero labels, zero words, zero letters anywhere on the canvas.

Every figure is the complete entire subject from end to end, fully centered in its cell with margin around all sides. Never a bust, never a headshot, never cropped, on flat neutral #E5E5E5 background with ABSOLUTELY ZERO FLOOR SHADOWS, zero drop shadows, zero contact shadows beneath the figures.
Clean planar low-poly papercraft facets with pure solid matte colors and flat-shading. ABSOLUTELY ZERO BLACK CREASE LINES, ZERO WIREFRAME, ZERO FOLD GUIDE LINES.
Exactly two eyes per figure: large cute round eyes with a prominent white circular catchlight reflection painted flat onto the facet. Never three eyes.

Flat surface 2D UV texture details: teeth, claws, whiskers, eyes, spots, stripes, and fur textures are painted flat onto closed facet surfaces, NEVER modeled as protruding 3D spikes or open mouth cavities.
100% closed foldable primary volumes: all snouts, jaws, and limbs are closed solid geometric blocks suitable for papercraft folding.
self_check: Are there exactly 6 cells arranged in a 3x2 grid?
Is every cell drawn in the identical eye-level three-quarter view with all feet on one flat ground plane?
Is there zero text and zero divider borders anywhere?
Is the background completely plain and flat with ABSOLUTELY ZERO FLOOR SHADOWS beneath the figures?
Are the figures clean planar low-poly facets without black outline strokes, wireframe, or black crease lines?
Is every figure complete from end to end without any cropped body parts or busts?
Does every figure have EXACTLY TWO cute eyes with white catchlight reflection?
Are teeth, claws, whiskers, stripes, and spots painted flat onto closed facet surfaces rather than separate 3D spikes or open mouth cavities?
